title: Sneak Peek: Zeteo’s Breakthrough Investigative Documentary on AIPAC
author: Team Zeteo
content:
Ahead of its release next week, watch this exclusive clip from our
investigative documentary into the American Israel Public Affairs Committee
(AIPAC). In this excerpt, former AIPAC chief lobbyist Douglas Bloomfield
speaks about a key moment in the group's history, how it transformed into the
political powerhouse it is today, and correspondent Dion Nissenbaum questions
him about the organization's relationship with the Israeli government.

The lobbying group has long fought efforts to register as a foreign agent,
stating that it operates as an American organization with no direction from
the Israeli government. But interviews and reporting by the **' Night Flower'
**team challenge that assertion by tracing evidence in cases over the past
four decades.

**' Night Flower: Inside AIPAC's Fight for Influence'** features interviews
with whistleblowers, insiders and former AIPAC officials like Bloomfield
and**** follows AIPAC from its roots as a one-man advocacy operation to the
present day, where it's playing a key role in the U.S. midterm elections.
